entities.name: Angremur
entities.description: A kingdom, likely a city-state, on Terisiare during the Dark Age.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria on which Angremur lay.

entities.name: Rogan
entities.description: Young king of Angremur who attacked the Flarg raiders and was later cursed to become a monster each night.

entities.name: Lacjsi
entities.description: A goblinhunter whose words inspired King Rogan.

entities.name: Flarg
entities.description: Goblin raiders near Angremur whom Rogan attacked.

entities.name: Torya Longshanks
entities.description: A farmer who broke Rogan's curse with her blood.

events.summary: Inspired by the goblinhunter Lacjsi, young King Rogan attacked the Flarg raiders near his country.
events.quote: the young king Rogan became inspired by the words of the goblinhunter Lacjsi and attacked the Flarg raiders near his country

events.summary: The massing goblins turned on Rogan's lands, burning farms and killing and eating many of his people.
events.quote: many farms burned down in goblin raids, and many of his people killed and even eaten by the goblins

events.summary: An enraged healer cursed Rogan with blood magic, turning him into a monster every night.
events.quote: Rogan himself was cursed by blood magic cast by an enraged healer

events.summary: The farmer Torya Longshanks broke Rogan's curse with her blood.
events.quote: until the farmer Torya Longshanks broke the curse with her blood

relations.note: Angremur was a city-state or small kingdom on Terisiare.
relations.quote: Angremur was a city-state or small kingdom on the continent of Terisiare
attacked the Flarg raiders near his country
